contexts.content: Building: Build a simple user greeting API. Use JavaScript/Node.js. Keep it simple and functional.
Using Express.js with RESTful conventions for simplicity and reliability
src/index.js - Express.js server with GET /api/greet/:name endpoint
Created greeting API endpoint with input validation and error handling. Start with npm start on port 3000.
API is production-ready with proper error responses. Consider adding rate limiting if exposed publicly.
Using React 18 with CDN and vanilla JavaScript for simplicity - no build tools needed. Vanilla HTTP fetch for API calls.
public/index.html - Greeting UI with responsive styling and form
public/app.js - React component that calls /api/greet/:name endpoint
Created interactive greeting UI. Start server with npm start and visit http://localhost:3000. Enter name to fetch greeting from API.
UI is production-ready with proper error handling and loading states. Consider adding React Query for more robust data fetching in larger projects.
Using Jest with Supertest for comprehensive API testing. Input validation uses character whitelisting with output sanitization for XSS protection.
src/index.test.js - 44 comprehensive tests covering validation, sanitization, API endpoints, error handling, and security scenarios
Enhanced API with input validation (sanitizeName, validateName functions) and complete test suite. Run tests with npm test. All 44 tests passing.
Consider adding rate limiting for production deployment. Frontend already properly URL-encodes input. Consider E2E tests with Playwright for full integration testing if expanding feature set.
